newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan stocks soar 3.18 percent on Sharif's win.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan stocks soar 3.18 percent on Sharif's win.

text.p: Pakistani stocks soared 3.18 percent on Tuesday on heavy buying fuelled by a landslide election win for Nawaz Sharif's Pakistan Muslim League, dealers said.

"The market has welcomed Sharif's win," dealer Shakil Anwar said. Research head of Crosby Securities, Anisur Rehman, said an excellent picture had emerged for the markets as Pakistan could now get a stable government. Sharif, seen as pro-business, said revival of the ailing economy was his top priority.
The Karachi 100-share index rose 50.74 points to end at 1,648. Gainers led losers 231 to 13.
